    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.

    * Chaotic Glide added.

    * Viper features added. {"Author":"NetStyx","Name":"A Realm Repopulated","Punchline":"The realm, now with more realm in it","Description":"This plugin aims to give players the ability to add more flavor npcs to the common areas of the game.","Changelog":"# 0.1.9.0 Changelog

Scenarios can now be given conditions, so they only bring their actors out at the right hour, in the right weather, or now and then by chance.

## Functional Changes
- Scenarios can now carry conditions - an Eorzean time window, one or more weathers, or a plain chance - and all of them have to hold before the scenario runs
- A running scenario is never cut short; its conditions are only acted on between runs
- The scenario editor and the scenario list both show whether a scenario's conditions currently hold
- Actors can be given a voice, so emotes with a voice line are now heard. It is taken over from character files and picked characters that have one

## Bugfixes
- Changing the scale, height or hidden gear of a newly added actor no longer changes it for the other newly added actors, or for the next ones added in that session
- `/arrp reload` now reloads the scenarios in the current area instead of opening the configuration window","TestingChangelog":"# 0.1.9.0 Changelog

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

{"Author":"GitHixy","Name":"LootView","Punchline":"See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.","Description":"LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

Works with every game language: English, Japanese, German and French.

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Currency drawer beside the overlay with every currency you hold, its cap and the weekly tomestone limit.
- A banner on screen when another player commends you.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner. Roll Need, Greed or Pass right from the panel, with the game's own loot window kept out of the way.
- Collectibles you already have (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles, portrait frames) are marked on their icon.
- Detailed item tooltips with item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots and market price.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any item to try it on, look it up, copy its name or blacklist it.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVACY

Your history is stored locally in your Dalamud configuration folder and is never uploaded. {"Author":"Zeffuro, Pie Lover","Name":"AetherBags","Punchline":"Never think too hard about your bags again!","Description":"This plugin replaces your inventory with it's own categorified inventory addon.","Changelog":"Adds a fast symbol picker letting you quickly insert any symbols into supported in-game text fields.
It is designed to make commonly used symbols easier to access without manually copying them from third-parties or typing them every time.

## Features
- Adds a floating quick-access "♥" button for opening the symbol popup
  - Allows the "♥" button position to be changed through drag-and-drop repositioning
  - Provides a symbol popup for quickly selecting and inserting symbols
  - List shows ALL existing custom symbols for FFXIV
- Supports opening the symbol popup through a configurable keybind
- Ensures only one symbol popup is open at a time
- Allows keybind-opened popups to be temporarily moved by dragging empty space inside the popup
- Includes a character selector toggle option for symbol selection behavior
- Adds an optional "Close popup on lost focus" setting to auto-close the popup when clicking outside of it
- Adds quick popup controls for closing the popup, changing the "♥" button position and opening the config window
- Includes a help tooltip explaining how to properly use some features

## Notes
The plugin is intended as a lightweight quality-of-life tool for players who frequently use special symbols in chat, search fields, notes or others","TestingChangelog":"# 1.0.0.5
- Added the ability to hide/show game categories in the Category Configuration.
- Added the ability to hide/show external/built-in categories in the Category Configuration.
- Fixed a crash that can occur when closing the Changelog window.
- Fixed a crash that could occur opening the housing menu.
- Added a submenu in the filter context menu to quickly hide/show key items/crystals.

{"Author":"NetStyx","Name":"A Realm Repopulated","Punchline":"The realm, now with more realm in it","Description":"This plugin aims to give players the ability to add more flavor npcs to the common areas of the game.","Changelog":"# 0.1.9.0 Changelog

Scenarios can now be given conditions, so they only bring their actors out at the right hour, in the right weather, or now and then by chance.

## Functional Changes
- Scenarios can now carry conditions - an Eorzean time window, one or more weathers, or a plain chance - and all of them have to hold before the scenario runs
- A running scenario is never cut short; its conditions are only acted on between runs
- The scenario editor and the scenario list both show whether a scenario's conditions currently hold
- Actors can be given a voice, so emotes with a voice line are now heard. It is taken over from character files and picked characters that have one

## Bugfixes
- Changing the scale, height or hidden gear of a newly added actor no longer changes it for the other newly added actors, or for the next ones added in that session

{"Author":"Bronya Rand","Name":"Things To Do In Eorzea","Punchline":"Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!","Description":"
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
    ","Changelog":"# LiteShade

A little less green.

Colour adjustments, GPose filters, optional depth of field and vignette.
Uses the game's own effects and leaves the UI alone.

Pick a preset or make your own. Share profiles and switch them automatically by zone, weather, Eorzea time and more.","TestingChangelog":"Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

AI Use: Assist
> AI was used to inquire about translations from English to Japanese to show there was at least an attempt to show that localization is supported. However said translations may not be accurate. Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display
> - Full Japanese [Claude+Gemini+Google Translate+DeepL+Japanese Dictionary] on UI and Objective Display
> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.","Tags":["to-do,list,track,task,objective,custom,utility,ui,other"],"CategoryTags":["utility","ui","other"],"IsHide":true,"InternalName":"ThingsToDoInEorzea","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","TestingAssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","IsTestingExclusive":true,"RepoUrl":"https://github.com/Bronya-Rand/ThingsToDoInEorzea.git","ApplicableVersion":"any","DalamudApiLevel":15,"TestingDalamudApiLevel":15,"DownloadCount":565,"LastUpdate":1787607241,"DownloadLinkInstall":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ThingsToDoInEorzea?isUpdate=False&isTesting=False&branch=api9&isDip17=True","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/goatcorp/DalamudPlugins/api9/plugins/ThingsToDoInEorzea/latest.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ThingsToDoInEorzea?isUpdate=False&isTesting=True&branch=api9&isDip17=True","LoadPriority":0,"ImageUrls":null,"IconUrl":null,"AcceptsFeedback":true,"FeedbackMessage":null,"FeedbackWebhook":null,"_isDip17Plugin":true,"_Dip17Channel":"testing-live"}

{"Author":"the Puni.sh Quest Squad","Name":"Questionable","Punchline":"A tiny quest helper plugin.","Description":"A small quest helper plugin designed to automatically do your quests for you where possible. {"Author":"Juan Medina","Name":"Gubal","Punchline":"Open web pages, wikis, and Lodestone articles in your browser directly from your chat bar.","Description":"            
            Inspired by the /wiki command from Guild Wars 2, Gubal lets you open web pages in your browser straight from the in-game chat bar. Named after the Great Gubal Library, just type a slash command followed by what you're looking for to jump directly to specific guides, item pages, and articles in your default browser.
            
            Commands and Examples:
            
            /wiki [query] - Search the FFXIV Console Games Wiki (opens in browser):
            - /wiki great gubal library (opens The Great Gubal Library dungeon guide)
            - /wiki sightseeing log (opens the Sightseeing Log guide)
            - /wiki relic weapons (opens the Relic Weapon progression guide)
            - /wiki blue mage spells (opens the Blue Mage spell list)
            
            /lodestone [query] - Search the official Lodestone (opens in browser):
            - /lodestone patch 7.56 (opens the Patch 7.56 notes directly)
            - /lodestone maintenance (opens latest server maintenance notices)
            - /lodestone eorzea database excalibur (opens official item details)
            - /lodestone community finder (opens the Community Finder)
            
            /gubal - Open the configuration window to add, edit, or customize search commands with the {text} placeholder.

{"Author":"Bronya Rand","Name":"KeybindsPlus","Punchline":"A almost complete replacement of XIV's keybind system.","Description":"KeybindsPlus is a plugin that allows you to bind *almost* any key on your keyboard and mouse to XIV actions, custom macros/commands, and supported Dalamud plugins. Bind any key, including those not normally supported by the game (F13-F24) to *almost* anything as if it were an actual registered keybind!

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

> * - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

(Thanks Miyabi)","Changelog":"Keybinds Plus is a plugin that allows you to bind _almost_ any key on your keyboard to either a XIV keybind or a supported Dalamud plugin.

Keybinds Plus allows you to bind any key, including those that are not supported by the game (F13-F24) to almost any game function (Shortcuts, Chat, Targeting, Hotbars) as well as any plugin that implements KeybindsPlus' IPC. You can also bind a key to a custom command (like `/wlmark`) or macro just like how the game does.

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

  > \* - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

This plugin is a early state and quite ambitious of me to do from prior plugins I've made. Why did I decide to write this? Simply put I wanted to use my Razer Miyabi keyboard macros and originally wanted to use F13 but game said no so I said `Fine. I'll do it myself.`  Also, past conversations. Thanks Miyabi :)
